title: Pack the Satchel
narrative: One more crate for the road. Add it to the end of the satchel and report how many crates it now carries.
instructions:
Write a function `pack(satchel, item)`.

- Add `item` to the END of the `satchel` list.
- Then return how many crates the satchel now holds.
hints: Do them in order: append first, then `return len(satchel)`.
append changes the list in place — you don't need to reassign it.
